svg.title: PayLink - Use Cases 3/3: Inside "Pay a Bill"

g.text: PayLink - Use Cases 3/3: Inside "Pay a Bill"
The four checks are FraudRule classes in a chain.
Daily and velocity numbers come from LimitRule (D-15);
min and max come from the biller service (US-06)
no answer within 10 seconds: re-query after 1, 5 and 15 minutes (D-11)
a duplicate success callback is ignored and logged
